description: This Java class defines a custom exception named ProvisioningCategoryNotFoundException, which extends an abstract exception class and is used to signal the absence of a provisioning category with a specific identifier.

classes.name: ProvisioningCategoryNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that a provisioning category with the specified ID was not found.

methods.name: ProvisioningCategoryNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a specific message indicating the invalid provisioning category ID.
